title: Rule specification file
description: Schema of spec/rules/*.yaml (validated after YAML-to-JSON conversion). Contract version 1.0.0.

language.description: Set only in language-specific files (spec/rules/csharp.yaml). Every rule in such a file must carry the matching ID prefix.

rationale.description: Why a reader may want to know. Every result is a heuristic, never a verdict.

paradigms.description: The rule applies to modules showing evidence of at least one of these. Empty: any module.

confidence.description: Typical confidence of a result; a detector may lower or raise it per result.

threshold.description: Default sensitivity: the value from which the detector emits a result. It does not decide whether code is acceptable. Empty object: the rule has no parameters. The raw measurement is always present in facts.

needsSemantic.description: True when the rule is meaningless without symbol resolution; it is skipped with reason needs-semantic-model otherwise.

requires.description: External input the rule needs; absent input produces a skipped-rule record with reason missing-input.
